en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Renaissance-style town hall building dominating a market square. The façade has ornate gables, a clock, corner turrets, and many windows. In the foreground is a busy open-air market with numerous people, stalls, carts, and a fountain with a statue. The lower left margin has printed red text with the place name and subject, and production details and date are printed along the bottom edge.
